myProfileData.heading: Your data and privacy
myProfileData.subheading: Review your personal data, export it or delete your account.

retention.heading: What we keep, and for how long
retention.description: Not everything is deleted on request. Some records we are legally required to keep.
retention.auditsWhy: So you can see how your scores move over time
retention.invoicesKept: 5 years after the tax period the invoice relates to
retention.invoicesWhy: Required by UAE tax and accounting law. Extended by 4 years during a tax audit or a dispute, or until that dispute is finally settled, and by 1 year from a voluntary disclosure.
retention.supportWhy: To handle your queries and any dispute

processors.heading: Where your data goes
processors.description: We use a small number of providers to run Signal. Your data is only shared with them for the purposes below.
processors.hostingPurpose: Runs the audits and stores your reports
processors.analyticsPurpose: Reads the traffic data you authorise, and nothing else
processors.crossBorder: If your data leaves the country your account is registered in, we only transfer it where the receiving country offers an adequate level of protection, or under approved safeguards.

export.heading: Export your data
export.description: Download everything we hold about you as a single file. This includes your profile, your audit history, your subscription and your billing records.
export.note: Available now. Large accounts may take a few minutes to prepare.

delete.heading: Deleting your account
delete.description: We will erase what we can and tell you plainly what we must keep.
delete.erasedPrompts: Your prompts, competitors and tracked keywords
delete.retainedInvoices: Invoices and payment records, because tax and accounting law requires it
delete.retainedRecord: A record that the deletion happened, so we can show we honoured your request
delete.retainedLegal: Anything we are required to keep for an open legal claim or investigation
delete.warning: This cannot be undone. If your workspace is shared, deleting your account does not delete audits that belong to other members.
delete.grace: Deletion is completed as soon as you confirm it. We keep a record that the deletion happened, so we can show we honoured your request.
delete.dialogBodyOne: This cannot be undone. We will erase your profile and login, your audit and report history, your prompts, competitors and tracked keywords, your connected analytics authorisation, and your consent and notification preferences.
delete.dialogBodyTwo: We must retain invoices and payment records for tax and accounting law, a record that the deletion happened, and anything required for an open legal claim or investigation.

signalSeoFactors.title: What makes up your SEO score
signalSeoFactors.note: Open a factor to see why and how to fix it
signalSeoFactors.unavailableBody: Core Web Vitals, structured data and on-page checks all read a page. A brand-only scan measures search presence and entity signals instead.
signalSeoFactors.technicalDesc: Speed, mobile and the signals Google reads
signalSeoFactors.technicalWhyGood: Your pages load and settle quickly enough for Google to treat speed as a strength.
signalSeoFactors.technicalWhyMixed: Pages are usable but slow enough that Google is discounting them.
signalSeoFactors.technicalWhyPoor: Pages are slow or move while loading, which Google treats as a poor experience.
signalSeoFactors.technicalWhyUnmeasured: No performance measurement came back for this scan, so this factor is not scored.
signalSeoFactors.technicalFixLcp: Cut the time to the largest image or heading on your slowest templates
signalSeoFactors.technicalFixCls: Reserve space for images and embeds so the page stops jumping
signalSeoFactors.technicalFixGeneral: Keep an eye on the slowest templates as you add content
signalSeoFactors.schemaDesc: Markup that tells engines what a page is about
signalSeoFactors.schemaWhyPresent: Schema markup is on the page, so engines can read what it describes rather than guessing.
signalSeoFactors.schemaWhyMissing: No schema markup was found, so engines have to infer what your pages are about from the text alone.
signalSeoFactors.schemaFix: Add JSON-LD for your organisation and your main page types
signalSeoFactors.onPageDesc: {{count}} checks across titles, headings and links
signalSeoFactors.onPageDescNone: No page-level checks ran on this scan
signalSeoFactors.onPageWhy: {{passed}} of {{total}} checks pass. The ones below that do not are where the points are.
signalSeoFactors.onPageWhyNone: No page-level checks ran, so there is nothing to report here yet.
